headline: TGA Clears Weight-Loss Tablets for Use in Australia
summary: Australia's Therapeutic Goods Administration cleared a daily Wegovy weight-loss tablet for use, with the product expected to launch before Christmas.
why: Regulatory approvals for pharmaceutical products expand addressable markets for drug developers and influence healthcare sector revenues.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: National regulatory approvals open new commercial markets for pharmaceutical treatments.
